title: Crystal Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Crystal/Christ Cathedral:the mapped four-point glass shell has large faceted sloping roof/wall planes,high sharp tips and inward valleys,blue-gray shared glazing grid,silver main frame lines and pale low entrance canopies/doors. Separate mapped73m open steel spire has staggered pointed blade/prism elements,actual gaps/open base,cross-connectors,simplified inner bell rows and a small pale circular pavilion with gold-toned shallow cap. Four existing shared glazing/polished steel/painted metal/concrete graphs,four browser levels and explicit approximate roof/entrance/terrain limits. Fine individual bell count,engineered steel details,reflected surroundings,interiors and exact thresholds are excluded or simplified.
